note: 荒野酒馆的酿饮商人；找玩家提供改良饮品的原料；随意口语；想做出能让 Sirius 认可的新饮品；品牌和人名保留，不写成药剂技能。

messages.raw: §fIt seems like my brew selection is rather small...I've recently heard that melon juice is really sought after so maybe it can enhance my drinks' flavors!
messages.text: It seems like my brew selection is rather small...I've recently heard that melon juice is really sought after so maybe it can enhance my drinks' flavors!
messages.zh: 我这儿的酿饮种类好像是有点少……最近听说西瓜汁特别抢手,没准加进去能让我的饮品更好喝!

messages.raw: §fWell done! I'm sure that even Sirius will enjoy my revolutionary melon refreshments.
messages.text: Well done! I'm sure that even Sirius will enjoy my revolutionary melon refreshments.
messages.zh: 干得漂亮! 我这款全新西瓜特饮,就连 Sirius 喝了肯定都说好。
